t: 忽必烈之孙铁木尔被选为蒙古可汗，年号为奥尔杰图。
te: Temür, grandson of Kublai, is elected Khagan of the Mongols with the reigning title Oljeitu.
dz: 忽必烈之孙铁木尔被选为蒙古可汗，年号为奥尔杰图。
de: Temür, grandson of Kublai, is elected Khagan of the Mongols with the reigning title Oljeitu.

t: 蒙古可汗帖木儿登基为元朝皇帝。
te: Temür, Khagan of the Mongols, is enthroned as Emperor of the Yuan dynasty.
dz: 蒙古可汗帖木儿登基为元朝皇帝。
de: Temür, Khagan of the Mongols, is enthroned as Emperor of the Yuan dynasty.

t: 将迈克尔九世·帕拉约洛戈斯加冕为拜占庭皇帝.
te: Coronation of Michael IX Palaiologos as Byzantine Emperor.
dz: 将迈克尔九世·帕拉约洛戈斯加冕为拜占庭皇帝.
de: Coronation of Michael IX Palaiologos as Byzantine Emperor.

t: 塞拉斯蒂内五世教皇在尼古拉斯四世教皇两年前去世后当选.
te: Election of pope Celestine V following the death of pope Nicholas IV two years prior.
dz: 塞拉斯蒂内五世教皇在尼古拉斯四世教皇两年前去世后当选.
de: Election of pope Celestine V following the death of pope Nicholas IV two years prior.

t: 圣克列斯丁五世在仅仅5个月后辞去教宗一职,回到他之前的生平,成为了一名乙酸隐士.
te: Saint Celestine V resigns the papacy after only five months to return to his previous life as an ascetic hermit.
dz: 圣克列斯丁五世在仅仅5个月后辞去教宗一职,回到他之前的生平,成为了一名乙酸隐士.
de: Saint Celestine V resigns the papacy after only five months to return to his previous life as an ascetic hermit.

t: 教宗博尼法斯八世当选,取代已辞职的圣塞莱斯丁五世.
te: Pope Boniface VIII is elected, replacing St. Celestine V, who had resigned.
dz: 教宗博尼法斯八世当选,取代已辞职的圣塞莱斯丁五世.
de: Pope Boniface VIII is elected, replacing St. Celestine V, who had resigned.
